mapper.select: SELECT card_type FROM app_character WHERE id = #{characterId} LIMIT 1
SELECT ensemble_chat_mode FROM app_character WHERE id = #{characterId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM app_character_member WHERE character_id = #{characterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM app_character_opening WHERE character_id = #{characterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY is_default DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT s.* FROM app_character_opening_segment s JOIN app_character_opening o ON o.id = s.opening_id WHERE o.character_id = #{characterId} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY o.sort_order ASC, o.id ASC, s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE app_character_member SET name = #{name}, tagline = #{tagline}, persona = #{persona}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, voice_config_json = #{voiceConfigJson}, image_reference_url = #{imageReferenceUrl}, is_primary = #{primaryMember}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND character_id = #{characterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app_character_member WHERE character_id = #{characterId} AND id = #{memberId}
